zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 阿方的床真的很舒服欸。

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 我真的快中風了！下來！

en.speaker: clark
en.text: Ah-Fang's bed is seriously so comfy.

en.speaker: billy
en.text: I am literally about to have a stroke! Get down!

zh-TW.speaker: bohan
zh-TW.text: 阿方在房間嗎？那我要去上他的床。

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 我不知道啊，有群人一直上我的床。下來！

en.speaker: bohan
en.text: Is Ah-Fang in the room? Gonna climb onto his bed.

en.speaker: billy
en.text: People keep climbing on my bed... Get down!

zh-TW.speaker: bohan
zh-TW.text: 幹麻那麼小氣，你的床就是大家的床啊，一起躺嘛。

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 我真的快中風了！下來！

en.speaker: bohan
en.text: Why so stingy? Your bed is everyone's bed, let's crash together!

en.speaker: billy
en.text: I am literally about to have a stroke! Get down!

zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 這阿方的方塊酥，你要吃嗎？還滿好吃的。

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 我不知道啊，有群人一直偷拿我的方塊酥。想吃不會自己買喔？

en.speaker: clark
en.text: These are Ah-Fang's wheat square cookies, want some? Pretty good.

en.speaker: billy
en.text: People keep stealing my cookies. Buy your own!

zh-TW.speaker: bohan
zh-TW.text: 你們先去吃吧，我不餓。

zh-TW.speaker: jerry
zh-TW.text: 你是水蛭喔？

en.speaker: bohan
en.text: You guys go ahead and eat first, I am not hungry.

en.speaker: jerry
en.text: Are you a leech or what?!

zh-TW.speaker: happy
zh-TW.text: 好啊都這樣啊，那我走。

zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 話也不是這樣說的...

en.speaker: happy
en.text: Fine, if that's how it's gonna be, I'm out.

en.speaker: clark
en.text: That's not what I meant at all...

zh-TW.speaker: happy
zh-TW.text: 好啊都這樣啊，那我離開。

zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 不是這樣，不是那個意思 xD

en.speaker: happy
en.text: Fine, if that's how it is, I'll just leave.

en.speaker: clark
en.text: No, wait, that's not what I meant xD

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 太 C 了吧，黑皮。

zh-TW.speaker: happy
zh-TW.text: 哎，還好拉，就只是正常發揮而已。

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: You carried so hard, Happy!

en.speaker: happy
en.text: Nah, it's alright, just normal gameplay.

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 太猛了吧，黑皮。

zh-TW.speaker: happy
zh-TW.text: 哎，就對面剛好失誤了，送了幾顆。

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: That was insane, Happy!

en.speaker: happy
en.text: Eh, the enemy team just made some mistakes and threw a couple kills.

zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 今天有局嗎？

zh-TW.speaker: happy
zh-TW.text: 等我一下，我十點後能打。

zh-TW.speaker: jerry
zh-TW.text: 喔喔好啊，那我也打一下好了。

zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 阿方來一下啦，別打暴雪了，趕快載 LoL 啦。

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 好啦，等一下啦。

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 那我也要打，我們這樣剛好五排。

en.speaker: clark
en.text: Anyone up for a game today?

en.speaker: happy
en.text: Give me a sec, I can play after ten.

en.speaker: jerry
en.text: Oh cool, sure, I'll hop in for a bit too then.

en.speaker: clark
en.text: Come on Billy, stop playing Blizzard games, hurry up and install LoL!

en.speaker: billy
en.text: Alright, hold on a bit.

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Count me in too, that makes a full five-stack!

name.zh-TW: 男十一舍 211 四人深夜寢室夜聊

zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 你們都還沒睡嗎？怎麼還沒睡？

zh-TW.speaker: jerry
zh-TW.text: 睡不著啊，聊一下啦。你覺得我們班哪個女生最好看？

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 又在問這個！對了，黑皮是不是有交女朋友呀？

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 好像有聽說欸。那老開後來怎麼樣了？

zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 老開喔？他八成又戴著耳機打程式打到早上了。

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 真的假的啦，明天早八微積分會爬不起來啦，快睡啦！

zh-TW.speaker: jerry
zh-TW.text: 好啦好啦，大家晚安。

zh-TW.speaker: ludwig
zh-TW.text: 晚安，關燈囉。

en.speaker: clark
en.text: Are you guys not asleep yet? Why are you still awake?

en.speaker: jerry
en.text: Can't fall asleep, let's chat! Which girl in our class do you think is prettiest?

en.speaker: billy
en.text: Asking that again! By the way, did Happy get a girlfriend lately?

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: I think I heard something! What about Kerry, what happened with him lately?

en.speaker: clark
en.text: Kerry? He's probably wearing headphones coding until dawn again.

en.speaker: billy
en.text: Seriously? We won't make it to tomorrow's 8 AM calculus, sleep already!

en.speaker: jerry
en.text: Alright alright, good night everyone.

en.speaker: ludwig
en.text: Good night, turning off the lights.
